rationale: Love extends beyond romantic vows into attention to small living things; ant and leaf retain this scale.

artwork.alt: A small ant walks along the edge of a broad green leaf in a pale watercolor field.
artwork.caption: Attention rests on a small living thing.

rationale: Urban density, living river and quiet interior space hold outward progress against the search within.

artwork.alt: A river winds between paper-cut buildings, seen from an empty room.
artwork.caption: The city grows; a little room remains within.

rationale: The unfinished clay deity raises the gap between worship and human responsibility without illustrating assault or promising rescue.

artwork.alt: An unfinished clay goddess rests on a workbench in soft side light; an AI-created interpretive study.
artwork.caption: An unfinished eye asks what worship alone cannot answer.

rationale: Fallen parijat resting on earth follows the poem’s turn from separation to shelter.

artwork.alt: Fallen white parijat blossoms with orange tubes lie loosely on shaded earth in a gouache and watercolor study.
artwork.caption: The earth receives the fallen flowers.

rationale: Spillway beauty with a small discarded wrapper holds both delight and the visitor’s responsibility.

artwork.alt: Water crosses a low spillway; one discarded plastic wrapper catches beside its mossy wall.
artwork.caption: The water flows; a trace remains.

rationale: The pond stone and withheld depth anchor the unheard pain beneath visible stillness.

artwork.alt: A watercolor study of a worn bathing stone beside still olive-green pond water.
artwork.caption: A worn stone rests beside still pond water.

rationale: Wide dusk and barely visible stars suggest absence while the world continues.

artwork.alt: Two faint stars emerge above a low grass horizon in a muted watercolor evening sky.
artwork.caption: The evening continues.

rationale: A resting, unclenched hand communicates gradual practice rather than a completed moral victory.

artwork.alt: A relaxed hand rests on a wooden chair arm in a spare graphite and watercolor study.
artwork.caption: The hand rests; understanding continues.

rationale: Charcoal weight and mythic burden hold the Atlas reversal without inventing a documentary person.

artwork.alt: An anonymous figure bends beneath a rounded stone burden in charcoal and ochre gouache.
artwork.caption: The weight returns to the shoulders.

rationale: An opening hand focuses on the poem’s final ambiguity of relinquishment, beyond literal game equipment.

artwork.alt: An open hand releases a plain counter above a spare tabletop, drawn in ink.
artwork.caption: The hand opens before the account is settled.

rationale: The rain-dark forest path remains specific to solitary, sustained waiting; replacing poem 825 removes the repeated forest mood.

artwork.alt: A rain-dark forest path bends beyond a tree and a few pale flowers.
artwork.caption: The path holds an open place.
